Introduction

Mercury was a 4-member South Korean girl group under Gaon Enterainment. They debuted on March 7, 2016, with the digital single "Don't Stop". They are presumed to be disbanded since August 2016 as they haven't been active since.

They were originally 3 members with Hanbit, Hyena, and Sehee, until April 2016 when SeoA joined and debuted with them in their second and final digital single "Let's Party", released on July 8, 2016.
